prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production animation cels for the faithful Sam & Max Hit the Road HD remake.
Image1 is the exact pixel geometry and local colors to redraw. Image2 is the APPROVED SAM character model; image3 is his APPROVED body/hand style sheet. Use2/3 for clean comic ink identity only; image1 decides the actual visible parts, pose, size, crop, colors and relative positions. These cels show ONLY Sam's brown cartoon HAND and long bent blue-gray SUIT SLEEVE with a small gray cuff, plus parts of a thin TAN BINDING ROPE at the left. No head, body, shoulders, hat, full Sam, woman, room, lock or other scene elements. The hand reaches left from the sleeve on the right. The sleeve is deliberately cut straight at its far right source edge, do not complete the missing body.
In the actual intro Sam touches and releases the loose end of the rope around the woman while watching Max offscreen. Preserve each hand grip and each tiny rope piece. The rope is MUCH thinner than a finger. In open poses the rope pieces are SEPARATE from the fingers. Keep all original transparent gaps between separate upper/lower rope fragments, tiny fibers and the hand. Do not connect or lengthen the rope, invent knots, add extra fingers, add tiny objects, or remove the small gray fleck when shown. Preserve which fingers are visible or hidden in each pose. The few tiny gray flecks are source details, not permission for an extra prop.
Redraw at precisely the present source sizes/positions on the1536x1024canvas. Keep the exact hand-to-sleeve proportions and narrow cuff. Do not enlarge the hand or make the sleeve shorter. Keep the same muted slate-blue sleeve base, deep blue shadow folds, light slate-blue upper fold, warm brown hand, gray cuff and tan/gold rope from image1. The master is not a reason to brighten this dim intro palette.
Clean, varied dark comic outlines, lighter fine internal finger/fold lines, smooth natural curves replacing pixel staircases, simple flat colors and one restrained cel shade. Match the approved Sam style. No pixelated edges, dithering, texture, gradients, glossy 3D, black sticker contour, halo, cast shadow, floor, backdrop, words, labels, panels, watermark or decorative markings. Fully TRANSPARENT outside the actual source parts; bright MAGENTA is padding only and must disappear to genuine alpha. Keep intentional small tan/gray opaque pieces.
Return ONE whole cel only: costume029_1955 at6x pixel geometry. Its source rectangle is954x438, upper-left291,293 on1536x1024. Preserve this exact pinching/pointing finger shape, long sleeve and straight crop on right.
There are EXACTLY THREE disconnected opaque groups: the tiny upper TAN rope chip; the large connected hand/sleeve with the lower TAN rope crossing behind the index finger; and ONE tiny detached TAN rope flake below the lower rope end. The last tiny TAN flake is essential: its source box isx9,y50,w1,h1, so on this reference its center is348,596 and approximate size6x6. Include it as a tiny smooth tan fiber chip, no outline circle, no new object. Keep transparency between it and the rope. The upper TAN chip remains separate. The main rope and finger group stay connected where the source is connected. Do not add other chips.
Image4 is our own T04 work-in-progress arm/rope sheet for palette and ink continuity, not a new approval. In its lower-left pose the tiny lower TAN flake was omitted; restore that source-confirmed small part. Use only the single pose from image1 here. Keep the approved Sam identity. Genuine transparent background, no glow.
